strings.app.name: Clout City: NYC
strings.app.description: Tap In. Blow Up. Make it in New York.
strings.voice.welcome: Welcome to Clout City. Tap in. Blow up.
strings.voice.bodega: Bacon, egg and cheese. Breakfast is sorted.
strings.voice.cloutUp: Your clout went up. People are noticing.
strings.voice.landmarkFlex: {landmark} looks great right now. Time for a photo.
strings.voice.clubDoor: Your clout is too low to get in tonight.
strings.voice.lockedHome: The Manhattan loft is locked. Earn more to move here.
strings.share.footer: Tap In. Blow Up. | Clout City: NYC

strings.events.mtaDelay.title: Train delay
strings.events.mtaDelay.body: Your train is running late, with no word on when it will show up.
strings.events.mtaDelay.wait.label: Wait for the train
strings.events.mtaDelay.walk.label: Walk instead
strings.events.mtaDelay.walk.result: You walked. Your legs are tired, but you feel good.
strings.events.mtaDelay.slice.label: Grab a slice while you wait
strings.events.mtaDelay.slice.result: You ate a slice while you waited.
strings.events.rentHike.title: Rent increase
strings.events.rentHike.body: Your landlord left a note: there is a new monthly building fee.
strings.events.rentHike.pay.label: Pay the fee
strings.events.rentHike.haggle.label: Argue it down
strings.events.rentHike.haggle.result: You argued it down to a smaller fee.
strings.events.rentHike.ignore.label: Ignore the note for now
strings.events.rentHike.ignore.result: You ignored the note. It is still bugging you.
strings.events.freePizza.title: Free pizza
strings.events.freePizza.body: A party at the pizza place ordered too much, and they are giving slices away.
strings.events.freePizza.grab.label: Grab a slice
strings.events.freePizza.pass.label: Keep walking
strings.events.clubPromoter.title: Club promoter
strings.events.clubPromoter.body: A promoter outside the club offers you a spot on the guest list, or cash to hand out flyers.
strings.events.clubPromoter.flyers.label: Hand out flyers for cash
strings.events.clubPromoter.flyers.result: You handed out flyers and got paid.
strings.events.clubPromoter.list.label: Get on the list and dance
strings.events.clubPromoter.list.result: You got in and danced for hours. People noticed you.
strings.events.clubPromoter.pass.label: Head home
strings.events.viralMoment.title: You went viral
strings.events.viralMoment.body: Someone filmed you at just the right moment, and the clip is taking off.
strings.events.viralMoment.post.label: Post it
strings.events.viralMoment.post.result: You posted it. Your follower count is climbing.
strings.events.viralMoment.keep.label: Keep it to yourself
strings.events.viralMoment.keep.result: You let it pass. It still made your day.
strings.events.phoneGrab.title: Phone grab
strings.events.phoneGrab.body: Someone on a scooter reached for your phone as they rolled past.
strings.events.phoneGrab.hold.label: Hold on tight
strings.events.phoneGrab.hold.result: You held on. They rolled off with nothing.
strings.events.phoneGrab.yell.label: Shout at them
strings.events.phoneGrab.yell.result: You shouted. They wobbled, nearly fell and scooted away.
strings.events.pickpocket.title: Pickpocket
strings.events.pickpocket.body: On the crowded platform, you feel a hand slip out of your pocket with some of your cash.
strings.events.pickpocket.shrug.label: Let it go
strings.events.pickpocket.chase.label: Chase them
strings.events.pickpocket.chase.result: You chased them down the platform. They dropped your cash and ran.
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.title: Golden hour on the bridge
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.body: The sun is setting behind the Brooklyn Bridge, and the light is perfect.
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.photo.label: Take a photo
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.photo.result: You took a great photo. People are liking it.
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.view.label: Just enjoy the view
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.view.result: You stood and watched the sky change. Peaceful.
strings.events.parkBusker.title: Busker in the park
strings.events.parkBusker.body: A busker with a guitar asks if anyone knows the chorus.
strings.events.parkBusker.sing.label: Sing the chorus
strings.events.parkBusker.sing.result: You sang along, and a small crowd clapped.
strings.events.parkBusker.tip.label: Give a tip
strings.events.parkBusker.tip.result: You gave a tip. The busker nodded thanks.
strings.events.parkBusker.walk.label: Keep walking
strings.events.touristPhoto.title: Photo request
strings.events.touristPhoto.body: A tourist asks you to take a photo of their group.
strings.events.touristPhoto.help.label: Take the photo
strings.events.touristPhoto.help.result: You took a good photo, and they thanked you.
strings.events.touristPhoto.point.label: Point them to someone else
strings.events.touristPhoto.point.result: You pointed them to someone else.
strings.events.bodegaCat.title: Bodega cat
strings.events.bodegaCat.body: The bodega cat jumps onto the counter and stares at you.
strings.events.bodegaCat.scratch.label: Pet the cat
strings.events.bodegaCat.scratch.result: The cat purred. You feel calmer.
strings.events.bodegaCat.treat.label: Buy the cat a treat
strings.events.bodegaCat.treat.result: The cat loved the treat. You made a friend.
strings.events.blockParty.title: Block party
strings.events.blockParty.body: A street is closed for a block party with music and food.
strings.events.blockParty.join.label: Join the party
strings.events.blockParty.join.result: You danced, ate and met your neighbors.
strings.events.blockParty.skip.label: Keep going
strings.events.downpour.title: Sudden rain
strings.events.downpour.body: It starts pouring with no warning.
strings.events.downpour.umbrella.label: Buy an umbrella
strings.events.downpour.umbrella.result: You bought an umbrella and stayed dry.
strings.events.downpour.run.label: Run for it
strings.events.downpour.run.result: You ran for it and got soaked.
strings.events.downpour.wait.label: Wait under an awning
strings.events.downpour.wait.result: You waited until the rain eased off.
strings.events.nameMisspelled.title: Wrong name on the cup
strings.events.nameMisspelled.body: The barista wrote a completely different name on your cup.
strings.events.nameMisspelled.post.label: Post the cup
strings.events.nameMisspelled.laugh.label: Laugh it off
strings.events.lateNightCart.title: Late-night food cart
strings.events.lateNightCart.body: A food cart on the corner is still serving.
strings.events.lateNightCart.plate.label: Get a plate
strings.events.lateNightCart.plate.result: You ate a hot plate of food. Much better.
strings.events.lateNightCart.skip.label: Keep walking

strings.actions.deliCoffee.blurb: A large coffee from the deli counter. Gives you energy.

strings.venues.lateLanternDeli.name: Late Lantern Deli
strings.venues.lateLanternDeli.blurb: Open all night. Sandwiches, snacks, coffee and a cat asleep on the counter.
strings.venues.nenasWindowArepas.name: Nena's Window Arepas
strings.venues.nenasWindowArepas.blurb: Cheese arepas griddled to order and handed through a walk-up window.
strings.venues.station30Av.name: 30 Av station
strings.venues.station30Av.blurb: An elevated platform on the N and W lines in Astoria.
strings.venues.repCountGym.name: Rep Count Gym
strings.venues.repCountGym.blurb: Squat racks, free weights and a playlist that never stops.
strings.venues.steamVentCoffee.name: Steam Vent Coffee
strings.venues.steamVentCoffee.blurb: Espresso, pastries and a few window seats. Hiring baristas.
strings.venues.rerunRacks.name: Rerun Racks
strings.venues.rerunRacks.blurb: Secondhand jackets, denim and sneakers, sorted by colour. Hiring retail staff.
strings.venues.glowmatic.name: Glowmatic
strings.venues.glowmatic.blurb: A neon-lit warehouse dance floor in Long Island City.
strings.venues.northsideDispatch.name: Northside Dispatch
strings.venues.northsideDispatch.blurb: A bike delivery depot. Grab a bag and start a run. Hiring riders.
strings.venues.twoMoonsDeli.name: Two Moons Deli
strings.venues.twoMoonsDeli.blurb: Coffee, egg sandwiches and late-night snacks in Williamsburg.
strings.venues.kettleAndClove.name: Kettle & Clove Roti Shop
strings.venues.kettleAndClove.blurb: Curry roti and doubles, wrapped to go.
strings.venues.stationBedfordAv.name: Bedford Av station
strings.venues.stationBedfordAv.blurb: An underground stop on the L line in Williamsburg.
strings.venues.stoopStrengthGym.name: Stoop Strength Gym
strings.venues.stoopStrengthGym.blurb: A basement gym with kettlebells, battle ropes and a chalk-dusted floor.
strings.venues.ninthHourCoffee.name: Ninth Hour Coffee
strings.venues.ninthHourCoffee.blurb: Pour-overs and oat lattes for the laptop crowd. Hiring baristas.
strings.venues.handMeUpThrift.name: Hand-Me-Up Thrift
strings.venues.handMeUpThrift.blurb: Racks of vintage tees, old band merch and one-off finds. Hiring retail staff.
strings.venues.brickwave.name: Brickwave
strings.venues.brickwave.blurb: A brick-walled club in Gowanus with a heavy sound system.
strings.venues.wallaboutFreight.name: Wallabout Freight Co-op
strings.venues.wallaboutFreight.blurb: A delivery co-op by the Navy Yard. Hiring riders.
strings.venues.owlHoursDeli.name: Owl Hours Deli
strings.venues.owlHoursDeli.blurb: Open all night on the Lower East Side. Coffee, sandwiches and snacks.
strings.venues.steamWindowDumplings.name: Steam Window Dumplings
strings.venues.steamWindowDumplings.blurb: Pork and chive dumplings, pan-fried or steamed.
strings.venues.stationUnionSq.name: Union Sq station
strings.venues.stationUnionSq.blurb: A busy underground hub on the 4, 5 and 6 lines under Union Square.
strings.venues.liftLaneFitness.name: Lift Lane Fitness
strings.venues.liftLaneFitness.blurb: Treadmills, rowers and a full rack of dumbbells in Chelsea.
strings.venues.overtimeEspresso.name: Overtime Espresso
strings.venues.overtimeEspresso.blurb: Espresso and cortados in the East Village. Hiring baristas.
strings.venues.sidecutStudio.name: Sidecut Studio
strings.venues.sidecutStudio.blurb: A small SoHo boutique stocking streetwear from local designers. Hiring retail staff.
strings.venues.afterglass.name: Afterglass
strings.venues.afterglass.blurb: A mirrored club near the Hudson with a late dance floor.
strings.venues.sixthFloorLabs.name: Sixth Floor Labs
strings.venues.sixthFloorLabs.blurb: A startup office near Madison Square. Hiring junior devs.

strings.welcome.title: Welcome to Clout City
strings.welcome.intro: Tap in. Blow up. Three quick things and the city is yours.
strings.welcome.birthYear.label: Year you were born
strings.welcome.birthYear.error: Pick the year you were born to continue.
strings.welcome.consent.label: I agree to the {terms} and the {privacy}.
strings.welcome.consent.error: Tick the box to agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy.
strings.welcome.audio.error: Choose a sound option: Play our music or I'll bring my own.
strings.ageGate.title: You need to be 18 or older to play.
strings.ageGate.body: Clout City: NYC is for adults only.
strings.legal.terms.title: Terms
strings.legal.terms.intro: These terms cover your use of Clout City: NYC, a game set in a shared, live version of New York City.
strings.legal.terms.age: Clout City: NYC is for players 18 and over. If you are under 18, you may not play.
strings.legal.terms.conduct: Treat other players with respect. Play fair and keep it friendly.
strings.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
strings.legal.privacy.intro: This policy explains what Clout City: NYC keeps about you.
strings.legal.privacy.stored: On this device we store that you confirmed you are 18 or over and when, the version of the Terms and Privacy Policy you agreed to and when, and your sound choice.
strings.legal.privacy.birthYear: We never store, log or send the year you were born. It is used only to check your age on the welcome card.
strings.landmarks.brooklynBridge.info: A stone-towered suspension bridge from 1883 linking Manhattan and Brooklyn, with a walkway above the traffic.
strings.landmarks.manhattanBridge.name: Manhattan Bridge
strings.landmarks.manhattanBridge.info: A blue steel suspension bridge between Chinatown and DUMBO. Trains rumble across it all day.
strings.landmarks.queensboroBridge.name: Queensboro Bridge
strings.landmarks.queensboroBridge.info: A steel cantilever bridge that hops over Roosevelt Island from Midtown East to Queens.
strings.landmarks.wedgeBuilding.name: Fifth Ave wedge
strings.landmarks.wedgeBuilding.info: A narrow triangular tower from 1902 where Fifth Avenue and Broadway cross.
strings.landmarks.decoSpire.name: Lexington Deco spire
strings.landmarks.decoSpire.info: An Art Deco skyscraper whose stainless-steel crown shines over Midtown East at night.
strings.landmarks.statueOfLiberty.name: Statue of Liberty
strings.landmarks.statueOfLiberty.info: The copper statue in the harbor, seen from the waterfront railing at the Battery.
strings.landmarks.washingtonSquareArch.name: Washington Square Arch
strings.landmarks.washingtonSquareArch.info: A marble arch at the south end of Fifth Avenue, framing Washington Square Park.
strings.landmarks.centralPark.name: Central Park
strings.landmarks.centralPark.info: Lawns, lakes and winding paths in the middle of Manhattan.
strings.landmarks.highLine.name: High Line
strings.landmarks.highLine.info: A park built on an old elevated rail line above the West Side.
strings.landmarks.prospectPark.name: Prospect Park
strings.landmarks.prospectPark.info: Meadows, woods and a lake in the middle of Brooklyn.
strings.landmarks.flushingMeadows.name: Flushing Meadows Corona Park
strings.landmarks.flushingMeadows.info: Wide lawns around the Unisphere, the steel globe from the 1964 World's Fair.
strings.landmarks.astoriaPark.name: Astoria Park
strings.landmarks.astoriaPark.info: A riverside park with a public pool and views of two bridges.
strings.landmarks.queensBallpark.name: Queens ballpark
strings.landmarks.queensBallpark.info: The baseball stadium by Flushing Bay, loud on game nights.
strings.landmarks.brooklynArena.name: Brooklyn arena
strings.landmarks.brooklynArena.info: A rust-coloured arena over Atlantic Avenue for basketball and concerts.
strings.landmarks.cityHall.name: City Hall
strings.landmarks.cityHall.info: The seat of New York City government, in a park in Lower Manhattan.
strings.landmarks.brooklynBoroughHall.name: Brooklyn Borough Hall
strings.landmarks.brooklynBoroughHall.info: The Greek Revival home of the Brooklyn Borough President, by Cadman Plaza.
strings.landmarks.queensBoroughHall.name: Queens Borough Hall
strings.landmarks.queensBoroughHall.info: The Queens Borough President's office, on Queens Boulevard in Kew Gardens.
strings.landmarks.midtownTerminal.name: 42nd St terminal
strings.landmarks.midtownTerminal.info: A Beaux-Arts rail terminal with a starry ceiling over its main hall.
strings.landmarks.pennStation.name: Penn Station
strings.landmarks.pennStation.info: A busy rail station under the West Side of Midtown.
strings.landmarks.jamaicaStation.name: Jamaica Station
strings.landmarks.jamaicaStation.info: A rail hub in Jamaica where commuter trains meet the airport train.
strings.landmarks.timesSquare.name: Times Square
strings.landmarks.timesSquare.info: Giant screens, crowds and street performers at the crossroads of Midtown.
strings.landmarks.dumbo.name: DUMBO
strings.landmarks.dumbo.info: Cobblestones and warehouses tucked between the Brooklyn and Manhattan bridges.
strings.landmarks.coneyIslandBoardwalk.name: Coney Island Boardwalk
strings.landmarks.coneyIslandBoardwalk.info: A wooden boardwalk along the beach, with rides and food stands on the other side.
strings.landmarks.flushingMainStreet.name: Flushing Main Street
strings.landmarks.flushingMainStreet.info: Bakeries, dumpling stalls and crowded sidewalks around the Main St stop.
strings.landmarks.september11Memorial.name: 9/11 Memorial
strings.landmarks.september11Memorial.info: Two reflecting pools mark where the Twin Towers stood. The names of the nearly 3,000 people killed on September 11, 2001, and in the 1993 bombing are inscribed around them.
strings.landmarks.bronxBallpark.name: Bronx ballpark
strings.landmarks.bronxBallpark.info: The baseball stadium in the South Bronx, a short walk from the Grand Concourse.
strings.landmarks.statenIslandFerry.name: Staten Island Ferry
strings.landmarks.statenIslandFerry.info: The orange ferry between St. George and Lower Manhattan, free to ride.
